page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on the x86_64 architecture with a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores using two threads per core. System memory totals 64.0 GB, establishing a 2.0 GB per core ratio. Cache hierarchy encompasses 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and 33 MB of shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, BMI2, ADX, and hardware AES encryption. The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, relying instead on network volumes for disk operations, and provides a 6 Gbps baseline network bandwidth interface.

Benchmark results position the instance with middle-tier multi-threaded compute capability and lower single-thread execution efficiency. In synthetic evaluations, stress-ng recorded a single-core score of 1109.99 and a multi-core score of 23557.71. Geekbench testing mirrors this disparity, registering a single-core score of 960.0 alongside a multi-core score of 8426.0. Multi-threaded compilation via Clang achieved 18724.0 points, while ray tracing reached 19799.0 points. Large-block memory tests measured 74.54 GB/s uncached read throughput and 34.35 GB/s write throughput. Workload-specific measurements include 23.27 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and 13.68 GB/s in static web serving throughput. For machine learning inference, the system achieved 40.5 prompt tokens per second and 10.19 generation tokens per second with a medium 7B model.

From a resource utilization standpoint, the 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio prioritizes core density over memory capacity, providing cost efficiency for compute-bound operations that do not demand extensive in-memory footprints. The primary tradeoff lies in moderate single-thread speed and reliance on external storage, which requires pairing with performant cloud disks for IOPS-sensitive applications. The instance is suitable for parallel batch workloads, multi-threaded code compilation, distributed web tier hosting, background task processing, and lightweight machine learning inference pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine operating on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include AVX-512F vector extensions, AES cryptographic acceleration, and 33 MB of shared L3 cache. The instance includes 6 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, while containing zero GPUs and no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence. Benchmark results indicate modest single-thread throughput alongside average multi-core processing performance, demonstrated by a PassMark CPU score of 22982.48 and Geekbench multi-core rating of 8426.0. Memory bandwidth reaches 74.54 GB/s for large-block reads and 34.35 GB/s for writes. This hardware profile suits parallelized compute tasks, multi-threaded compilation, batch data transformation, and horizontal web serving.
